text:
sam: Heads-up: prod spike in toolhook responses being rejected by the validator since 03:12 UTC. Console only shows model-level rejects, can't tell which routes are hitting it. :eyes:
ops-bot: Alert: toolhook_schema_rejects rate increased 6x for tenant-redwood-prod.
anya: saw the alert, digging. Is this on fncall path or toolhook adapter? Any example payloads?
sam: toolhook adapter. Mostly failures are missing the nested `metadata` object or `items` is an array vs object. Traffic concentrated on chart-importer route.
kevin: console sampling currently global 1%. We really need per-route sampling + original payload link. Otherwise triage is impossible.
julie: UX request: surface a small "rejection waterfall" on each route page showing counts for schema, parse, timeout, and coercion. Also a quick toggle for permissive/soft mode for emergencies.
miguel: permissive toggles worry me. Proposal: implement `soft-validate` so runtime accepts but tags the response and increments a `soft_reject` metric that doesn't increment customer billable errors. That buys time to fix callers.
anya: implementation sketch: runtime runs `validate(response)`; if fail and route has `soft_validate=true`, emit telemetry with `validation.outcome=soft_fail` and call `adapter.coerce()` then continue. If `soft_validate=false` -> hard reject.
kevin: billing note: ensure `soft_fail` doesn't count toward quota/penalty. We'll need a clear flag in the billing pipeline to exclude those. Also add alerting on `hard_reject_rate` separate from `soft_reject_rate`.
sam: short-term mitigation: set chart-importer-prod validator config `drop_extra_fields=false` and increase sampling to 100% for 1hr so we can capture examples. Can we do that from console?
julie: I'll add a temporary toggle for validator config per-route, gated behind 2FA and audit log. Mockup in a bit.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary: apply `validator_mode=soft` to chart-importer-prod at 10% traffic starting now.
deploy-bot: canary succeeded at 10% -> ramping to 100% over 15m.
miguel: follow-up: telemetry should include `validator_version` (git sha) and an `adapter_coercion_steps` list so we can pinpoint which coercion fixed the shape. Keep details minimal to avoid PII.
anya: agreed on redaction. Add `input_schema_preview` truncated to 512 chars and `output_schema_preview` similarly. No raw PII.
kevin: we should also add `route_id` and `caller_sdk_version` to the sampled entries so product can correlate with SDK releases.
sam: action items: anya: add telemetry fields + implement soft-validate in runtime (P0). kevin: add billing exclusion for `soft_fail` (P1). julie: console mock for validator toggle + 2FA gate (P1). miguel: add `validator_version` + coercion steps in logs (P1).
julie: noted, will ping design and security for 2FA gating, mock in 2 hrs.
sam: thanks all — will monitor metrics, please post back when telemetry samples are available. :thumbsup:
